SELECT 
    p.panemark AS panel_id,
    p.powratew AS power_rated_w,
    perfsol.measpoww AS current_power_w,
    (perfsol.efficiency_profile->'degradation'->>'cumdegpct')::numeric AS degradation_pct,
    (perfsol.efficiency_profile->'current_efficiency'->>'efflosspct')::numeric AS soiling_loss_pct,
    (inv.power_metrics->>'inverteffpct')::numeric AS inverter_efficiency_pct,
    -- IEL = MeasuredPowerW * (1 - InverterEfficiencyPercent/100)
    perfsol.measpoww * (1 - (inv.power_metrics->>'inverteffpct')::numeric / 100) AS inverter_efficiency_loss,
    -- TSL = (PowerRatedW * CumDegPct/100) + (MeasuredPowerW * SoilingLossPct/100) + IEL
    (p.powratew * (perfsol.efficiency_profile->'degradation'->>'cumdegpct')::numeric / 100) +
    (perfsol.measpoww * (perfsol.efficiency_profile->'current_efficiency'->>'efflosspct')::numeric / 100) +
    (perfsol.measpoww * (1 - (inv.power_metrics->>'inverteffpct')::numeric / 100)) AS total_system_loss

JOIN performance perfsol ON p.panemark = perfsol.solmodref
JOIN inverter inv ON p.hubregistry = inv.siteref

    p.panemark AS panel_id,
    p.powratew AS rated_power,
    perfsol.measpoww AS measured_power,
    CAST(p.powratew AS numeric) * (perfsol.efficiency_profile->'degradation'->>'cumdegpct')::numeric / 100 AS degradation_loss,
    perfsol.measpoww * env.soillosspct / 100 AS soiling_loss,
    perfsol.measpoww * (1 - (inv.power_metrics->>'inverteffpct')::numeric / 100) AS inverter_loss,
    CAST(p.powratew AS numeric) * (perfsol.efficiency_profile->'degradation'->>'cumdegpct')::numeric / 100 +
    perfsol.measpoww * env.soillosspct / 100 +
    perfsol.measpoww * (1 - (inv.power_metrics->>'inverteffpct')::numeric / 100) AS TSL
FROM panel p
JOIN performance perfsol ON p.panemark = perfsol.solmodref
JOIN inverter inv ON p.hubregistry = inv.siteref
JOIN environment env ON p.hubregistry = env.arearegistry
JOIN plant pl ON p.hubregistry = pl.growregistry;
